data.title: AS Roma vs Sassuolo - Match preview and team news
data.content:
Manager Alberto Aquilani receives a massive boost in midfield as Kristian Thorstvedt returns to the squad after serving a suspension, putting him in line for a direct spot in the starting XI.

However, the Neroverdi continue to navigate a lengthy injury list of their own. Defenders Fedde Leysen and Yeferson Paz remain long-term absentees due to ACL injuries.

The midfield is also stretched thin, with Ismaël Koné sidelined by an ankle problem and Daniel Boloca recovering from a knee issue. [...] #### Sassuolo

Sassuolo Calcio arrive in 17th place with just eight points, enduring a miserable run of form near the relegation zone. Alberto Aquilani’s side have lost four consecutive Serie A matches and remain winless in six overall. Following a 1-1 draw with AC Milan, they suffered heavy defeats against Frosinone (4-2), Como (2-0), Lazio (6-2), and Fiorentina (4-2), leaking goals in 11 straight matches while struggling severely away from home.

### Predicted lineups [...] Paulo Dybala remains sidelined with a calf injury; although he has resumed individualized training, the staff opted not to risk him before the international break.

The Giallorossi are also missing first-choice goalkeeper Mile Svilar due to a broken finger, captain Lorenzo Pellegrini with a thigh issue, and wing-back Devyne Rensch, who faces three weeks out with a groin injury.
